# StockForge POS

> Offline-first native desktop retail POS & inventory management system with embedded SQLite ACID storage for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

StockForge is a zero-latency desktop point-of-sale and store inventory software engineered for independent retailers, grocery marts, supermarkets, hardware stores, dairies, and boutiques in Nepal and worldwide. It operates 100% offline with zero cloud dependency and zero cloud latency.

## Key Capabilities
- **100% Offline-First Architecture**: Powered by embedded local SQLite with ACID transaction guarantees. Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux without internet connectivity.
- **Sequential Invoicing**: Automated sequential bill numbering (`BILL-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`) compliant with Nepal retail audit standards.
- **Multi-Unit Inventory**: Full support for decimal weights and measurement units (piece, kg, litre, packet, box, meter, dozen).
- **Snapshot Profit Analytics**: Real-time Gross Profit and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) tracking locked at the moment of sale.
- **Customer Khata & Dues**: Complete customer credit ledger tracking previous dues, current bill dues, and total outstanding balances directly on printed receipts.
- **Hardware Compatibility**: Native support for standard 80mm and 58mm ESC/POS thermal receipt printers, USB barcode scanners, and cash drawers.
- **Staff & Payroll Management**: Staff directory with monthly wage disbursement vouchers and salary advance tracking.
- **Database Backup & Portability**: 1-click clean `.sql` database script export for offline USB archiving, plus optional Google Sheets cloud sync when connected.
- **Bilingual Interface**: Seamless toggle between English and Nepali (नेपाली) with automatic currency sync (`Rs.` / `रु.`).

## System Requirements
- Operating System: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 11+ (Intel & Apple Silicon), Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora)
- Memory: Minimum 2 GB RAM (4 GB recommended)
- Storage: 150 MB disk space for application + SQLite database
- Network: None required for day-to-day operation

## Contact Information
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Support: Direct phone and WhatsApp support available
- Website: https://stockforge.app/
